explanation: Do not cache get_user results for the lifetime of a process. After a user's role is revoked, a cached result could still grant the old role. #640 is the issue reference for this hazard.
For this db.Query call, check err before scheduling rows.Close(). If the query fails, rows is nil, so calling Close on it would fail.
Use setTimeout with a zero delay for measure(el) so layout can settle before measurement. The comment says queueMicrotask would run too early.
Do not log the contents of the Secret<String> token loaded here. Its Debug output must show only a redacted value. Secret<String> is the token's type.
RetryCount and the Http.Retry setting in appsettings.json must be changed together so the code and configuration stay aligned. appsettings.json is the configuration file; Http.Retry is the setting.
Before mapping the buffer, ensure offset is divisible by pageSize. The mmap operation rejects an offset that is not page aligned. offset and pageSize are the values in that constraint.

Keep the trailing slash on build/ in this rsync command. It makes rsync copy the contents of the source directory into DEST, rather than copying the build directory itself. rsync is the external command whose behavior matters.

The BRIN index on created_at is chosen for its size: the comment says it is about 1% the size of a btree index. The events table is appended in time order, which supports that choice. created_at is the indexed column.

Replace this loop that repeatedly checks flag with a futex based wait. The work is complete when lock_acquire in src/sync/lock.c sleeps while waiting instead of spinning. The path and symbol point to where that behavior must change.

Consult the failover section of the runbook for why dbo.RebuildStats runs on the secondary. doc:runbook#failover is the documentation anchor; dbo.RebuildStats is the procedure this comment applies to.
Keep this timeout below 60 seconds because the upstream proxy terminates idle requests after 60 seconds. The assigned value of 30 seconds meets that constraint.
Keep Widget's destructor virtual. If it becomes non-virtual, deleting a derived object through a Widget pointer could skip the derived destructor. #915 is the issue reference for this hazard.
Run this PRAGMA before any write on each database connection. The foreign_keys setting applies per connection, so enabling it on one connection does not enable it on others.

Keep Name as a fixed length ShortString rather than changing it to string. The containing record is written directly to disk byte for byte, so changing the field's representation would change the stored record format. Name is the field concerned.

Bind caller supplied p_id as a variable in this DELETE statement. Concatenating caller input into an EXECUTE IMMEDIATE statement would allow SQL injection. :1 is the bind placeholder, and USING p_id supplies its value.
